notes:
Rejuvenation (WSI/Williams-Sonoma family). Direct HTML fetch of the Sale-department leaf pages (/shop/sale/all-clearance/, /shop/sale/open-box-deals/) returned HTTP 403 with a generic 'due to website restrictions we are unable to display the requested page' WAF error body on every attempt (3 tries, paced), while the homepage and the sibling /shop/new-and-featured/* leaf pages (used for bs62/na62) returned HTTP 200 in the same session - this looks like a path-specific WAF rule targeting /shop/sale/*, not a full-host block, so per §1 I stayed on the same host/access tier and used the site's own Constructor.io product-data API (ac.cnstrc.com, key=key_9BhS51IOFNhJejk4 - the sole product-data source for this SPA per this company's prior Home-Decor pass) to both discover and quantify the listings; every qty below is a direct API total_num_results value cross-checked by an exhaustion count (paged unique-product-ID count), both matching exactly. SALE vs CLEARANCE: the 'Sale' department (group_id=sale, count=1468) is a mixed hub of clearly TEMPORARY promotional sub-collections - 'All Sale'/sale-all (667, matches the homepage 'Sale: Up to 60% off' banner), 'Everyday Free Shipping' (496), and named percent/dollar-off campaign tiles ('Lighting Up To $400 Off', 'Furniture Up To $600 Off', 'Cabinet & Wall Hardware Starting At $14', room-qualified 'Sale <Room>' facets, etc.) - these are excluded as generic/temporary Sale per brief §3, not Clearance. Two children ARE genuine permanent clearance/outlet merchandising and are included: (1) 'All Clearance' (all-clearance, 366) - sampled product records all carry the site's own productPriceType facet = 'Clearance' (not 'Sale'/'Discount'), confirming the site's own taxonomy treats this as clearance stock. (2) 'Open Box Outlet Deals' (open-box-deals, 159) - product titles are prefixed 'Open Box:'/'OPEN BOX:' and descriptions explicitly read 'An Outlet Deal may show wear from moderate use...' - a genuine permanent open-box/outlet listing, matching the brief's 'Outlet' target term. Verified All Clearance and Open Box Outlet Deals share ZERO product IDs (366 vs 159, 0 overlap) - genuinely different listings, not aliases, kept as separate rows. A THIRD candidate was investigated and is recorded flagged rather than silently included or dropped: 'Vintage' (group_id=clearance-sale-vintage, count=141), a sibling of 'All Clearance' under the 'Sale' parent (same taxonomy depth, not nested under All Clearance). Its sampled items show MIXED productPriceType values (Clearance, Sale, Discount all present in a 5-item sample) and only 67 of its 141 products (48%) overlap with All Clearance - i.e. it is a vintage-department view spanning multiple discount types, not a clearance-specific listing on its own. Recorded per brief §3's 'if uncertain, still record with a MANUAL REVIEW flag' instruction rather than guessing either way.

[POLICY UPDATE 2026-09-11] Removed 1 Outlet-classified row(s) per corrected policy: Outlet is not Clearance.
